convert_matting_to_nerfies: convert a matting format video folder to Nerfies format with camera poses and scaled images
run_matting_to_nerfies_cli: run the CLI tool to convert matting video data to Nerfies format with optional camera subpath
get_cam_data: build a camera data dictionary with focal length, principal point, and distortion parameters
get_scene_data: create a scene data dictionary with scale, center, bounding box, and near far bounds from a camera source
overwrite_images_flag: run the matting to Nerfies conversion with the overwrite images flag to regenerate all output images
